description: Retrieves style usage analytics for a published Figma library. Returns data about how styles (colors, text styles, effects, grids) from the library are being used across your organization. Requires Enterprise plan and library_analytics:read scope. Group results by 'style' to see per-style metrics or by 'file' to see which files use the library's styles.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's 'cursor' field. Omit to get the first page of results.
cursor.title: Cursor

file_key.description: The unique file key of a published Figma library. Obtain this from the library URL (e.g., figma.com/file/FILE_KEY/...) or via the Get Team Styles endpoint. Note: This API is only available on Enterprise plans.
file_key.title: File Key

group_by.description: How to group the analytics data: 'style' returns usage stats per style, 'file' returns usage stats per file using the library.
group_by.title: Group By

name: get_library_analytics_style_usage_data

data.description: Contains the structured analytics data, pagination information, and the actual usage rows.
data.title: Data

cursor.description: The cursor to use for fetching the next page of data. This field is present only if 'next_page' is true.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_page.description: A boolean indicating whether more data is available for a subsequent request.
next_page.title: Next Page

rows.description: An array of analytics data, with each object's structure depending on the 'group_by' parameter. If 'group_by' is 'style', items will conform to the 'Row' schema. If 'group_by' is 'file', items will conform to the 'Row1' schema.
rows.title: Rows

Row.description: Analytics data when grouped by 'style'. Each row represents one style from the library.

files_using.description: Number of distinct files using this style.
files_using.title: Files Using

style_type.description: Type of style: FILL, TEXT, EFFECT, or GRID.
style_type.title: Style Type

teams_using.description: Number of distinct teams using this style.
teams_using.title: Teams Using

usages.description: Total instance count of this style across all files in the organization.
usages.title: Usages

Row.title: Row

Row1.description: Analytics data when grouped by 'file'. Each row represents one file using the library.

file_name.description: Name of the file using styles from the library.
file_name.title: File Name

team_name.description: Name of the team that owns the file.
team_name.title: Team Name

usages.description: Total style instance count from the library within this file.
usages.title: Usages

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace containing the file, if applicable.
workspace_name.title: Workspace Name

Row1.title: Row1
